g.text: Part: PPR-C02 — Anti-reach baffle chute Qty 1 Material PLA
Overall: X 190.00 Y 150.00 Z 90.00 mm; unless noted printed tolerance ±0.30 mm
Interface: 4x Ø4.5 through; 100x60 outlet; staggered 93 mm ledges
Fastener: 4x M4x12 + washer; insert/nut: 4x M4 nyloc nuts on metal side; tightening: 1.2 N.m
Edge distance: 8 mm boss centre; Ø14 boss; mating: hopper and metal cutter chamber
Print: outlet down; 0.24 mm; 5 perimeters; support: ledge undersides only
Dimensions govern over SVG scale. Ream/fit only after printing the PPR-TC01 tolerance coupon.
